short_summary: HealthRate is a SaaS platform that uses AI and data to optimize reimbursement and payment for high-cost healthcare claims, targeting providers and payers.
long_summary: HealthRate is an award-winning SaaS platform that provides pricing optimization for high-cost healthcare claims. It uses decades of domain experience, trillions of data points, advanced statistical methods, and AI/ML to proactively identify the optimal source and cost of care. The platform is unbiased, independent, and requires no patient intervention or claims auditing. It has case studies with major health systems like Ohio State University Medical Center, showing significant savings. The company has been nominated for HealthcareMN 2024 Start Up of the Year and won HIMSS 2025 Best In Show Payer Analytics. The CTO is Jeff Sage.
